items.academy:app_freq_transmitter.e0: The wireless matrix is not initialized.
items.academy:app_freq_transmitter.e2: Link failed. Perhaps the matrix has reached its capacity or the signal is out of range.
items.academy:app_freq_transmitter.e3: Link failed. Perhaps the node has reached its capacity or the signal is out of range.
items.academy:app_freq_transmitter.s0_0: Please right-click a wireless matrix or node to start establish link from.
items.academy:app_freq_transmitter.s2_0: Right click any wireless node nearby to establish link. Click any other blocks to quit.
items.academy:app_freq_transmitter.s3_0: Right click any wireless receiver or generator nearby to esablish link. Click any other blocks to quit.
items.academy:factor_ac.ability_interf.cantuse: You can't use this interference block.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.aero_separator.d: After a brief charge, instantly create a small vacuum area that deals suffocation damage to all creatures inside (including yourself!).
items.academy:factor_aerohand.air_blade.desc: Compress air in one direction to form an unstable air blade and launch it, causing armor-piercing damage. The longer the distance, the less damage.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.air_cooling.desc: Use strong air cooling to reduce your overload.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.air_jet.desc: Lunge forward by jetting backward. This skill has a relatively short cooldown, but cannot be used during Offense Armor.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.air_wall.desc: Create a compressed gas wall that knocks back all targets around you and destroys projectiles.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.airflow.desc: Passive skill. Reduce suffocation damage. You can breathe underwater when skilled.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.ascending_air.de: Passive skill. Control the rising airflow so that your falling damage does not exceed a certain value.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.bomber_lance.des: Eject a high-pressure nitrogen lance to deal massive damage and knock back the target.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.flying.desc: You can fly when enabled. Cannot coexist with Offense Armor.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.offense_armour.d: Use all-round compressed nitrogen to protect yourself. Slow down, reduce damage taken, knock back nearby entities and destroy projectiles.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.storm_core.desc: Create a core at the target location that attracts surrounding creatures, then explodes after a while.
items.academy:factor_aerohand.volcanic_ball.de: Compress a large mass of air into a ball and launch it. Knock back the enemy hit. The longer the distance, the less damage.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.arc_gen.des: Arouse a weak electrical arc, which causes slight damage on the area it hits. If it directly hits a flammable block, it will have a chance to ignite it.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.body_intens: Fine-tune your bioelectricity to improve your physical ability for a short duration.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.charging.de: Generate electric current to charge the thing in your hand or electric blocks in the world.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.iron_sand.d: Separate and manipulate the iron in sand to create a changeable and dangerous attack effect.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.mag_manip.d: Project a safe magnetic image of a targeted metal block and throw it to damage enemies. The original block is never moved.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.mag_movemen: Generate a strong magenetic field and pull yourself towards some magnetic target. Extremely useful when moving or escaping.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.mine_detect: Close your eyes and feel the flow of magnetism, allowing you to see a hint of precious mineral resources around you.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.railgun.des: Shoot the coin out at a high speed with electromagnetic induction. Cause destructive damage where it impacts.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.thunder_bol: Compresses an enormous amount of electricity into a powerful bolt, bursting out and damaging anything in it's area.
items.academy:factor_electromaster.thunder_cla: Manipulate the magnetic field in the atmosphere to create thunderclouds, and guide the electricity down to cause a devastating strike of lightning.
items.academy:factor_generic.brain_course.desc: Undergo training for your brain. Increases Max CP by 1000.
items.academy:factor_generic.brain_course_adva: Develop the thinking ability of your brain deeply. Increases Max CP by 1000 and Max Overload by 100.
items.academy:factor_generic.mind_course.desc: Learn how to relax your brain better. Speed up CP recovery by 20%%.
Pull together a small amount of electrons to generate a threatening beam.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.electron_missi: Hold together a HUGE amount of electrons in a cloud and use some of it to attack each time.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.jet_engine.des: Use the propulsive force of electrons launch yourself into the air. Will generate a light-shield to protect yourself in the flight.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.light_shield.d: Forms electrons into a shield. High-speed moving electrons will destroy anything that attack you, and damage anything touch you closely.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.meltdowner.des: Extreme high-energy electron beam that melts down walls and metals.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.mine_ray_basic: After a long time of practice, you can make your electron beam suitable for harvesting minerals without destroying them.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.mine_ray_exper: With understanding of how to control the intensity of electrons better, you can now harvest mineral resources more efficiently.
After a long time of practice, you can almost harvest the useful resources in the ore perfectly.
Because of the high-intensity radiation, the target hit by beam is doubly vulnerable to attacks for a few seconds.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.ray_barrage.de: Shoot your high-energy ray at a Silicon Barn to scatter it into a ray barrage that destroys everything in front of you.
items.academy:factor_meltdowner.scatter_bomb.d: Manipulate more than one electronics group to attack. As a result, you can't control the impact point accurately.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.cruise_bomb.d: Control small water balls to cruise and attack nearby creatures and projectiles automatically. Requires a bucket of water to activate.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.insulation.de: Passive skill. Reduce skill damage taken by creating an area that blocks electrons passing. Especially effective against Electromaster and Meltdowner.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.liquid_shadow: Build a humanoid creation with water, which will follow you until the skill is terminated or it dies. Requires a bucket of water to activate.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.overload_thin: Force the brain to think at over speed, consuming a lot of overload to recover computing power.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.paper_drill.d: Use Perfect Paper to create a huge drill which will follow your eyesight and continuously cause damage. Requires a stack of paper to activate.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.perfect_paper: Pour your mind into the paper to make it hard and flexible. You can use some special items after learning.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.psycho_harden: Make your body extremely hard through your psychokinesis. During this period, you are immune to any damage but cannot move.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.psycho_needli: You can now accurately control the attitude of flying projectiles! Throw out a needle through your psychokinesis, causing armor-piercing damage.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.psycho_slam.d: You can control other creatures now! Hit the enemy diagonally upward through your psychokinesis, then slam them down, causing multi-segment damage.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.psycho_throwi: Throw out a piece of cobblestone through your psychokinesis. Performance improves if the cobblestone is treated and easy to operate.
items.academy:factor_telekinesis.psycho_transm: Pick up the falling item within sight into your bag.
items.academy:factor_teleporter.dim_folding_th: Boost your damage against enemies by generating a tiny space folding phonemonon.
items.academy:factor_teleporter.flashing.desc: Use multiple teleportations in a short time to maneuver through the air.
Rip apart your enemy’s inside and inflict gory damage. The over-bloody effect may make you feel uncomfortable.
items.academy:factor_teleporter.location_telep: Memorize your current location and teleport back from anywhere far away afterwards.
Marks where you are looking at as the destination, and teleports you there.
items.academy:factor_teleporter.penetrate_tele: Derive the thickness of an obstacle in front of you, and teleport straight through it.
items.academy:factor_teleporter.shift_tp.desc: Teleport a block about the means of the coordinate plane. The space-folding phonemonon will hurt any entity on the teleportation path.
items.academy:factor_teleporter.space_fluct.de: Strengthen your space-folding ability to cause more dangerous critical damage.
items.academy:factor_teleporter.threatening_te: Teleport items to somewhere around you. Sometimes just a small fragment is able to kill an enemy.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.blood_retro.desc: Stir the blood flow of organic enemies, making their vessel burst and die in extreme pain.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.dir_blast.desc: Triple the force of punching into the object, making it extremely destructive. Will break blocks on area it hits.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.dir_shock.desc: Seize the counterforce when punched into object and redirect it onto the object itself, making the punch more powerful.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.ground_shock.des: Apply a powerful shock on the ground and direct it forward, which breaks the ground and launches enemies into the air.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.plasma_cannon.de: Manipulate a large area of air flow with extreme precision to form a plasma body. Throw it out to cause a disastrous explosion.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.storm_wing.desc: Manipulate the velocity of air to form four micro-whirlwinds at your back, and fly in high speed using forces they generate. Will break blocks nearby if inexperienced.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.vec_accel.desc: Boost jumping force for an instant to accelerate yourself.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.vec_deviation.de: Cancel the velocity of projectiles flying towards you, and cancels a portion of combat damage.
items.academy:factor_vecmanip.vec_reflection.d: Reflects the dangerous incoming attacks towards your line of sight, and make your opponent bear it.
items.academy:magnetic_coil.desc:
Overcharges the developer
In order to rewrite personal reality
items.academy:media_sisters_noise.desc: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun S OP1
